import numpy as np

r2 = np.load('/work/fwd/r2/run.npz', allow_pickle=True)
mlp = r2['L0_MLP']

mlp_in0 = mlp[0]  # tokens BOS,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9
mlp_in2 = mlp[2]  # all 5s

# Max token-induced variation (different tokens)
token_diffs = [np.max(np.abs(mlp_in0[i] - mlp_in0[j])) 
               for i in range(1,10) for j in range(i+1,10)]
# Max position-induced variation (same token=5, different positions)
pos_diffs = [np.max(np.abs(mlp_in2[i] - mlp_in2[j])) 
             for i in range(1,10) for j in range(i+1,10)]

print(f"Max token-induced variation: {max(token_diffs):.4f}")
print(f"Max position-induced variation: {max(pos_diffs):.4f}")
print(f"Ratio (pos/token): {max(pos_diffs)/max(token_diffs)*100:.2f}%")
